purpose: Reduce baked-in top highlights and simplify the existing light/dark icon artwork

prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: final full-bleed square bitmap artwork for an existing macOS application icon. Edit the attached target, preserving the exact identity, proportions, position, scale and silhouette of the two vertically offset overlapping rounded diamond sheets, centered with the same margins. Simplify the rendering into restrained, clean, nearly flat vector-like filled shapes. REMOVE ALL baked-in top lighting, bright top bands, spotlights, glossy edge highlights, neon rim outlines, bevels, specular reflections, glows, drop shadows, grain and texture. Background must be one perfectly uniform flat color, identical at top, bottom and all corners, no gradient and no vignette. The shapes may have only extremely gentle broad color transitions, not lighting; clean sharp antialiased edges with NO outlined border, no plastic or glass thickness. Keep overlap an easily readable solid diamond-shaped color region. Keep the whole combined symbol approximately 70% of the square canvas width as in the reference. Full-bleed fully opaque 1024x1024 SQUARE with square corners; NO rounded tile, NO outer margin, NO border, NO text, NO mockup. The system will mask the final icon. LIGHT version: uniform warm-neutral near-white #FAFAFA background, upper sheet cool cyan to blue, lower sheet periwinkle to violet, central overlap restrained saturated cobalt blue. Desaturate slightly for a calm premium feel.
